title: Usufruct

inlines.v: U'SUFRUCT, noun [Latin usus, use, and fructus, fruit.] The temporary use and enjoyment of lands or tenements; or the right of receiving the fruits and profits of lands or other thing, without having the right to alienate or change the property.
